heading: Certain contributions to Trump accounts

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Gross income of an account beneficiary shall not include any qualified general contribution to a Trump account of the account beneficiary.

tree.heading: Definitions
tree.text: Any term used in this section which is used in section 530A shall have the meaning given such term under section 530A.

notes.text: Effective DateSection applicable to taxable years beginning after Dec. 31, 2025, see section 70204(e) of Pub. L. 119–21, set out as a note under section 128 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 119–21, title VII, § 70204(c)(1), July 4, 2025, 139 Stat. 186.)

ancestors.heading: ITEMS SPECIFICALLY EXCLUDED FROM GROSS INCOME
